caseName: Leroy v. Great Western United Corp.
caseNameFull: Leroy, Attorney General of Idaho v. Great Western United Corp.

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 439 U. S. 1065.] Motion of National Association of Insurance Commissioners for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motions of Attorney General of New York and Attorney General of Ohio for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae denied.
